figures.finding: The film workers' agreement covers the director but sets no minimum: its fee table lists Regie as 'freie Vereinbarung' (free agreement); the Austrian Film Institute instead caps the director's fee it recognises in a funded budget, from EUR 36,000 on a EUR 200,000 film to EUR 300,000 on a EUR 10 million film, less 15% for a debut, and up to 30% more for a director with two features made.

value.overpaymentCondition: at least two features already made

figures.applies: Austria; the KV minimum table from 1 July 2026; ÖFI guide rates for films it funds, guidelines valid from 1 January 2026.
